g.text: 1. USB / J4 POWER AND OPTIONAL 3.3 V SUPPLY

g.desc: 1. USB / J4 POWER AND OPTIONAL 3.3 V SUPPLY

g.text: 5 V DEFAULT | no output buffer | two opposing edge connectors

g.desc: 5 V DEFAULT | no output buffer | two opposing edge connectors

g.text: Output levels follow VCC_LOGIC. No SN74LVC125APW on this board.

g.desc: Output levels follow VCC_LOGIC. No SN74LVC125APW on this board.

g.text: R5 fitted: VCC_LOGIC = input 5 V (default). R6/U3/C4 DNP.

g.desc: R5 fitted: VCC_LOGIC = input 5 V (default). R6/U3/C4 DNP.

g.text: 3.3 V: REMOVE R5, fit R6/U3/C4 and REPLACE U1 with CD74AC161E.

g.desc: 3.3 V: REMOVE R5, fit R6/U3/C4 and REPLACE U1 with CD74AC161E.

g.text: Never power CD74ACT161E from 3.3 V. Never fit R5 and R6 together.

g.desc: Never power CD74ACT161E from 3.3 V. Never fit R5 and R6 together.

g.text: J4: regulated 5 V input. USB OR J4; use only one power source.

g.desc: J4: regulated 5 V input. USB OR J4; use only one power source.

g.text: No power-on reset: startup phase is undefined. C1 next to U1 pin 16.

g.desc: No power-on reset: startup phase is undefined. C1 next to U1 pin 16.

g.text: PASS2/4/6/8/10 direct; no USB power on J2/J3. No 433 MHz support.

g.desc: PASS2/4/6/8/10 direct; no USB power on J2/J3. No 433 MHz support.

g.text: ACT / 5 V: TTL CLK; VIH >= 2 V, VIL <= 0.8 V; target up to 80 MHz.

g.desc: ACT / 5 V: TTL CLK; VIH >= 2 V, VIL <= 0.8 V; target up to 80 MHz.

g.text: Both mechanical interfaces UNVERIFIED. Confirm mating pin numbers.

g.desc: Both mechanical interfaces UNVERIFIED. Confirm mating pin numbers.

g.text: J2 LEFT EDGE, J3 RIGHT EDGE: 5 pads on F.Cu + 5 on B.Cu each.

g.desc: J2 LEFT EDGE, J3 RIGHT EDGE: 5 pads on F.Cu + 5 on B.Cu each.

g.text: AC / 3.3 V option: CLK 0..VCC; limit 64 MHz over -55..125 C.
